title: Are Guys also tired of generic AI giving you absolute diabolical wrong answers about your 10K??
author: Kartik_tyagi13
selftext: So as you can read from the Header that AI is now everybody's go to tool to get through 10-K and so every time I do this I always reverify the data and questions I asked because let's be honest AI is good but not perfect and it does hallucinates numbers pretty much once I started noticing it is quite obvious so I ask it to give me the citations and then the page number is incorrect or the paragraph is off or the AI just couldn't corelate data and don't get me started on the tables part. Drop down your frustrations and solutions
